basis.title: CNA e-Tool Estimated Useful Life Table
basis.by: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
basis.label: Lighting- interior common space
basis.note: Family properties 25 years, elderly 30. US multifamily housing. HUD's row is interior common-space lighting and does not name the lamp technology.

basis.title: Design standards: employer's requirements – Technical Manual (ER-DFE-XX-XX-T-X-0201, revision A-C01)
basis.label: Internal luminaires, emergency lighting fittings and lighting controls: 25 years
basis.note: Printed page 294. Interior LED luminaires (LED required, p.302) and emergency lighting fittings; batteries dealt with separately (5.8.15). Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Light fittings
basis.note: Printed page 43. Light fittings, lamp type not stated; building fit-out so interior. BDFO Building fit-out (when in books separately from building cost). Printed DV 20%, SL 13.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

basis.title: Future Buildings Standard: final stage impact assessment (RPC-MHCLG-25104-IA), 24 March 2026
basis.by: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (UK)
basis.label: "20 years for light fittings and ventilation equipment"
basis.note: Printed page 77. One value for two groups. Light fittings in new buildings are LED (the IA applies LED cost learning). 'Ventilation equipment' is generic; mapped to the ventilation component types it clearly includes. Assumption for new non-domestic buildings in England; the IA says the lifetimes are in line with BS EN 15459 (Annex/Appendix E), but they are stated as the department's own modelling assumptions, not a reproduced table. Round-number economic-appraisal assumptions, not observed lives. Same values as the January 2021 Future Buildings Standard consultation IA (separate file), so the two are not independent.

open_questions: HUD's row is interior common-space lighting in general and does not name the technology; LED drivers and modules often fail before the fixture body. A source specific to LED fixtures is needed.
Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
